papers.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
papers.abstract: Frozen LLM agents learn explicit world models through external memory, keeping a revisable natural-language rulebook that is compiled into executable code and verified against observed transitions.

papers.title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
papers.abstract: A benchmark that tests whether 3D foundation models estimate real-world physical distances between point pairs, using 6,400 frames from 100 scenes with measured distances.

papers.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract: A critic that tracks each correction as a persistent note until the agent actually resolves the diagnosed problem, improving coding-agent resolve rates on several benchmarks.

papers.title: A GPU-Parallel Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Hebero, a GPU-parallel Isaac Lab benchmark of 40 manipulation tasks, plus DGPO and IW-ABC methods for training one multi-task policy from sparse rewards and few demonstrations.

papers.title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
papers.abstract: A refinement method that keeps rejected candidate configurations and iteratively improves them, reducing rollouts needed to optimize prompts, skills, and harnesses.

papers.title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
papers.abstract: Station, an open-world simulated scientific ecosystem with supervisor and meta-reflection mechanisms, rediscovers a large share of findings from recent ICLR oral papers without web access.

papers.title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
papers.abstract: AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for LLM-agent black-box optimization across five domains, studying the effects of tools, task information, and the LLM's role in search.

papers.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
papers.abstract: A schema-free method where an LLM agent generates enterprise data by acting through policy-enforcing simulated APIs, ensuring structural validity and reasonable distributional fidelity.

papers.title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: SpecFold reuses parent computation across draft branches in diffusion LLM speculative decoding, using a Triton kernel to reach up to about 2x throughput with comparable task performance.

papers.title: Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research with Structured Harness
papers.abstract: Incremental-OEDR updates existing research reports instead of regenerating them, using structured evidence pools and temporal evaluation to cut token use and search calls.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed

* Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode
* Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
* Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
* Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay

What's changed

* Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
* Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done
* Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers
* Added a warning to `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable` and `marketplace add` when the settings file they write to does not load

What's changed

* Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions allowing what they should block
* Improved how `prompt` hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
